EmailTemplateUpdateRequest.description: Request body for updating an email template

subject.example: Codul tau de activare Copacul Meu

body.description: Email content body supporting short codes like {{name}} and {{code}}

description.example: Email template for sending activation code upon registration

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Request body for completing password reset

code.description: 6-digit password reset code received via email

UserRegisterRequest.description: Payload for registering a new user

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Request body for initiating forgot password flow

TreeCheckinRequest.description: Tree check-in request with GPS coordinates and observation data

latitude.description: User's current GPS Latitude at the tree

longitude.description: User's current GPS Longitude at the tree

wateringLevel.description: Observed watering level of the tree

watered.description: Whether the user watered the tree during this check-in

proposedSpecies.description: Optionally proposed new species for this tree

notes.example: Tree shows new spring buds, soil was dry before watering

deviationMeters.description: Deviation distance in meters from original tree GPS coordinates

valid.description: Whether the check-in is valid (deviation within 2.0m radius)

watered.description: Whether tree was watered by user

tree.description: Current tree state after this check-in

originalLatitude.description: Original GPS Latitude coordinate before check-in averaging

originalLongitude.description: Original GPS Longitude coordinate before check-in averaging

lastWateredAt.description: Timestamp when the tree was last watered

locationDescription.example: Cismigiu Park, near the central lake

proposedByUserId.description: User ID who proposed the tree

reviewedByUserId.description: Admin user ID who reviewed the proposal

rejectionReason.description: Rejection explanation if proposal was rejected

TreeCreateRequest.description: Payload for registering a new tree

species.description: Tree botanical or common species name

healthLevel.description: Observed health level of the tree

lastWateredAt.description: Timestamp when the tree was last watered

height.description: Estimated height of the tree in meters

age.description: Estimated age of the tree in years

locationDescription.example: Cismigiu Park, near the central lake

notes.description: Additional forestry observations, notes, or maintenance tags

TreeRejectRequest.description: Request body for rejecting a proposed tree

reason.description: Reason for rejecting the tree proposal
reason.example: Tree already exists at these GPS coordinates

TreeSpeciesCreateRequest.description: Payload for registering a new tree species

name.description: Full formatted display name including vernacular name

aliases.description: Known synonyms, alternate spellings, or aliases

CheckinStatusResponse.description: User check-in availability status for a specific tree

canCheckin.description: Whether the user is currently eligible to check in on this tree

lastCheckinAt.description: Timestamp of the user's last valid check-in on this tree

nextAvailableCheckinAt.description: Timestamp when the user can next check in on this tree

remainingCooldownSeconds.description: Remaining cooldown in seconds until the next check-in is allowed
